Position: Generative AI Engineer

Job Type: permanent

Notice Period: Immediate Joiner 

Experience: 5 - 10 Years 

Location: Pan India




Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and deploy AI and Generative AI applications using modern programming languages and AI frameworks.
Implement prompt engineering techniques to optimize outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs).
Integrate AI services and models into enterprise applications through APIs and SDKs.
Build, deploy, and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and LLM-based solutions for conversational and knowledge-driven use cases.
Collaborate with architects, data scientists, and engineering teams on model implementation and system integration.
Perform model testing, evaluation, and tuning to improve accuracy, relevance, and performance.
Follow best practices for secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready AI development.
Work with cloud platforms and DevOps pipelines to support CI/CD processes for AI and ML workloads.
Document AI solutions, prompts, workflows, and integration patterns to ensure maintainability and reusability.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, tools, and enterprise AI best practices.
